cases.scenario: Daytime call, service the business offers, caller in service area.
cases.caller_input: I need someone to fix a leaking water heater this week.
cases.expected_behavior: Identifies service, checks FSM availability, offers real slots, books, SMS confirm.
cases.pass_criteria: Correct service + real slot booked; SMS sent; owner notified.

cases.pass_criteria: Non-urgent after-hours call booked, not dropped to voicemail.
